title: DIC Australia Pty Limited - proposed acquisition of Pacific Inks (Australia) Pty Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: DIC Australia Pty Limited (DIC Australia) proposed to acquire the business assets, inventory and goodwill of Pacific Inks Australia Pty Limited (Pacific Inks) (the proposed acquisition).
body_sections.Market definition: The parties overlap in the manufacture and supply of water-based liquid inks.  The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the proposed acquisition in the national market for the manufacture and supply of water-based liquid ink.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in any relevant market. In forming this view, the ACCC had regard to the following factors: -  the competitive constraint imposed by other local suppliers of water-based liquid inks, -  the countervailing power exercised by large packaging customers; -  the low barriers to entry and expansion; and -  the competitive constraint imposed by imported water-based inks in terms of providing a substitutable product, potentially enabling customers to import water-based inks directly and the competitive constraint this is likely to impose on the merged entity.
